resources.string: Photos use this rate. Videos are capped at it but never sped up: a slower video keeps its own rate. 29.97 and 23.976 are written as 30 and 24.
H.264 video with AAC audio. Clip sound, music and voiceover are mixed with their volume, mute and fades. Everything is fitted to the frame, with black bars where the shapes differ.
Add a video or photo to the main track first. Audio-only export isn\'t supported.
These files can\'t be read: %1$s. Import them again, then export.
These clips reach past the end of their file (it may have changed): %1$s. Trim them, then export.
Extra video tracks (picture-in-picture) aren\'t exported yet. The main track, text, stickers and every audio track are.
Text or stickers that run past the end of the video are cut there.
Where sounds overlap loudly enough to clip, they\'re turned down together just enough to avoid distortion.
Some audio couldn\'t be measured, so where it overlaps other sound it\'s treated as full volume and the mix may be quieter there.
Clip effects aren\'t rendered yet, so they won\'t appear in the video.
Audio that runs past the end of the video is cut there.
Keep Veyro open until the export finishes. Leaving this screen cancels it.
